documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

analysis.summary: Emmvee Photovoltaic Power Limited reported strong financial and operational performance for Q1 FY27, with revenue from operations reaching INR 1,555 crores and EBITDA standing at INR 548 crores at a 35% margin. The company's order book strengthened to 9.9 gigawatt supported by fresh order inflows of approximately 1.5 gigawatt. Management highlighted record production across solar modules and cells, along with steady progress on its ongoing 6-gigawatt integrated TOPCon cell and module expansion. Furthermore, the company outlined medium-term plans for backward integration into ingot and wafer manufacturing subject to market conditions. Emmvee Photovoltaic reported a record Q1FY27 performance with strong growth in revenue and profitability, driven by higher production volumes and integration benefits.

guidance.claim: The company is targeting approximately INR 2,400 crore of EBITDA by the close of FY27.
guidance.quote: We are targeting approximately INR 2,400 crore of an EBITDA by the close of FY27.

demand_outlook.claim: Management notes that growing electricity demand, energy security, and domestic manufacturing are creating long-term opportunities.
demand_outlook.quote: Growing electricity demand, increasing energy security, domestic manufacturing initiative, electric mobility, energy storage, green hydrogen, and data centers are creating a significant long-term opportunity for the Indian solar industry.

demand_outlook.claim: Domestic supply of high-efficiency TOPCon cells continues to remain relatively tight.
demand_outlook.quote: Domestic supply of high-efficiency TOPCon cells continues to remain relatively tight, which should support the operating environment for established and compliant cell manufacturers.

demand_outlook.claim: Domestic cell supply remains tight, supporting the margin environment for established manufacturers.
demand_outlook.quote: Domestic cell supply remains tight, especially for TOPCon cells.

capex_expansion.claim: The ongoing 6-gigawatt integrated TOPCon cell and module expansion continues to progress according to plan.
capex_expansion.quote: Our ongoing 6 gigawatt integrated TOPCon cell and module expansion continue to progress according to plan.

capex_expansion.claim: The total project cost for the 6-gigawatt expansion is estimated at approximately INR 5,500 crores, including hard costs of around INR 4,600 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: The total project cost is estimated at approximately INR 5,500 crores, including hard costs of around INR 4,600 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: Following expansion completion, total manufacturing capacity is expected to increase to approximately 16.3 gigawatt of modules and 8.9 gigawatt of cells by end of FY2027.
capex_expansion.quote: Following the completion of this expansion, our total manufacturing capacity is expected to increase to approximately 16.3 gigawatt of modules and 8.9 gigawatt of cells by end of FY2027.

capex_expansion.claim: The proposed ingot and wafer facility will have a total of 9 gigawatt and is planned in two phases.
capex_expansion.quote: The proposed facility will have a total of 9 gigawatt and is planned in two phases, with 5 gigawatt targeted in FY2029 and the remaining 4 gigawatt in FY2030.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin for Q1FY2027 improved to 35% compared to 34% in Q1FY26.
margins_costs.quote: An EBITDA margin improved to 35% compared to 34% in Q1FY26 and 33% in Q4 FY26.

margins_costs.claim: Profit after tax stood at INR 380.3 crores, registering growth of 103% over Q1FY26.
margins_costs.quote: Profit after tax stood at INR 380.3 crores, registering growth of 103% over Q1FY26.

margins_costs.claim: Finance costs reduced significantly to INR 11.1 crores compared to INR 53.1 crores in Q1FY26.
margins_costs.quote: due to lower finance costs that reduced significantly to INR 11.1 crores compared to INR 53.1 crores in Q1FY26.

orders_capacity.claim: The order book further strengthened to 9.9 gigawatt, supported by fresh order inflows of approximately 1.5 gigawatt.
orders_capacity.quote: Our order book further strengthened to 9.9 gigawatt, supported by fresh order inflows and approximately 1.5 gigawatt.

orders_capacity.claim: Current installed capacity stands at 10.3 gigawatt of solar modules and 2.94 gigawatt of TOPCon cells.
orders_capacity.quote: Our current installed capacity stands at 10.3 gigawatt of solar modules and 2.94 gigawatt of TOPCon cells.

orders_capacity.claim: Effective module capacity utilization stood at 45% compared to 44% in both Q1FY26 and Q4 FY26.
orders_capacity.quote: Effective module capacity utilization stood at 45% compared to 44% in both Q1FY26 and Q4 FY26.

orders_capacity.claim: Cell capacity utilization improved further to 83% compared to 68% in Q1FY26 and 79% in Q4 FY26.
orders_capacity.quote: Cell capacity utilization improved further to 83% compared to 68% in Q1FY26 and 79% in Q4 FY26.

orders_capacity.claim: Order inflow for Q1FY27 was 1,484 MW.

capital_allocation.claim: Debt funding of approximately INR 3,300 crores has been tied up at the cost of less than 8% for the expansion.
capital_allocation.quote: Debt funding of approximately INR 3,300 crores has been tied up at the cost of less than 8%.

capital_allocation.claim: Capital expenditure for the backward integration facility is expected to be funded largely through internal accruals.
capital_allocation.quote: The capital expenditure for the same is expected to be funded largely through internal accruals.

capital_allocation.claim: The backward integration project will be funded largely through internal accruals.
capital_allocation.quote: To be funded largely through internal accruals.

management_commitments.claim: The module line of the 6-gigawatt facility is expected to be commissioned by December 2026.
management_commitments.quote: The module line is expected to be commissioned by December 2026, followed by the cell line by March 2027.

management_commitments.claim: Total manufacturing capacity is expected to increase to approximately 16.3 gigawatt of modules and 8.9 gigawatt of cells by end of FY2027.
management_commitments.quote: Following the completion of this expansion, our total manufacturing capacity is expected to increase to approximately 16.3 gigawatt of modules and 8.9 gigawatt of cells by end of FY2027.

management_commitments.claim: Backward integration into ingot and wafer manufacturing is planned with 5 gigawatt targeted in FY2029.
management_commitments.quote: The proposed facility will have a total of 9 gigawatt and is planned in two phases, with 5 gigawatt targeted in FY2029 and the remaining 4 gigawatt in FY2030.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
